8:   function startThruster() {

12:     osc.type = 'sawtooth';
13:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(100, audioCtx.currentTime);
14:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.05, audioCtx.currentTime);
15:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);

23:     thrusterOsc.osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.1);
24:     thrusterOsc = null;
25:   }

27:   function playExplosion() {

53:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');

55:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
56:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;

58:   // starfield background
59:   const stars = Array.from({length: 100}, () => ({

100:       this.x = Math.max(this.radius, Math.min(width - this.radius, this.x));
